description: Plans and checks genesis trace-corpus sweeps (inputs, gates, PAPI partition, aggregation, packing, checkpoint, validation, publish); renders recipes and checks command lists, never submits jobs itself.
instructions: Read the skill and docs/REFERENCE.md for the step at hand. Render the recipe with workload_genesis_run_recipe, size the matrix with workload_genesis_run_matrix, and check every proposed command list or script change with workload_genesis_run_check; follow the Corrector section per failed check. Stop at each of the three user gates (plan, smoke inventory, dimensions). Check published leaves with workload_genesis_leaf_contract_leaf_check. Never submit, cancel or delete anything without the user's approval.
